hooks.command: IFS= read -r -d '' j; case "$j" in *"git commit"*) printf %s "$j" | bun {src}/packages/ai-os/src/relay/hook.ts;; esac

IFS= read -r -d '' j; s=${j#*\"session_id\":\"}; s=${s%%\"*}; d=${RELAY_HOME:-${LOCALAPPDATA:+$LOCALAPPDATA/aphrody/relay}}; d=${d:-${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/aphrody/relay}; [ -e "$d/sessions/$s.pending" ] && printf %s "$j" | bun {src}/packages/ai-os/src/relay/session-hook.ts deliver; exit 0

IFS= read -r -d '' j; c=${j#*\"command\":\"}; c=${c%%\",\"*}; c=" ; ${c//[;&|(]/ ; } "; c=${c//  / }; c=${c//  / }; r=; case "$c" in *"; cat "*|*"; grep "*|*"; sed "*|*"; ls "*|*"; find "*|*"; du "*|*"; curl "*|*"; cd "*) r="coreutils: use rg, fd, sd, dua, xh, jaq or Read/Grep/Glob/Edit, absolute paths, no cd";; esac; case "$c" in *"; git commit "*) case "$c" in *" -- "*) ;; *) r="plain git commit takes the whole shared index: bun scripts/commit.ts -m <msg> --push <paths>";; esac;; esac; case "$c" in *"; git add -A"*|*"; git add . "*|*"; git add --all"*|*"; git stash"*) r="shared tree: stage explicit files (bun scripts/commit.ts), never stash";; esac; case "$c" in *"; git add "*".env "*) r="the .env vault is never staged";; esac; l=${c,,}; case "$l" in *"; cp "*system32*|*"; mv "*system32*|*"; rm "*system32*|*"; del "*system32*|*"; copy "*system32*|*"; move "*system32*|*"; tee "*system32*|*">"*system32*|*set-content*system32*|*out-file*system32*) r="C:/Windows/System32 is never modified";; esac; [ -n "$r" ] && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"%s"}}' "$r"; exit 0

IFS= read -r -d '' j; s=${j#*\"session_id\":\"}; s=${s%%\"*}; d=${RELAY_HOME:-${LOCALAPPDATA:+$LOCALAPPDATA/aphrody/relay}}; d=${d:-${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/aphrody/relay}; [ -e "$d/sessions/$s.pending" ] && printf %s "$j" | bun {src}/packages/ai-os/src/relay/session-hook.ts deliver; exit 0
